title: Summarize a short incident policy
system: You summarize policy text. Keep required facts. Stay short.
prompt:
Summarize the policy in at most 60 words. You must keep these three facts: P1 incidents page the on-call engineer; logs are retained for 30 days; notify security@example.com for suspected breaches.

Acme Widgets Ltd Incident Policy: P1 incidents page the on-call engineer. Logs are retained for 30 days. Notify security@example.com for suspected breaches. Laptops stay on site. This document is a demo only.
